newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-June postal and communication up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-June postal and communication up 33 pct.

text.p: Turnover in China's postal and telecommunications sector hit 80.91 billion yuan ($9.75 billion) in the first half of this year, up 32.9 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the Economic Daily said on Friday.

China added 5.67 million telephone lines in January-June and the number of telephone users rose by 10.9 million to 72.7 million, the newspaper quoted figures from the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications as showing.
Nationwide, China had 72 telephones per 1,000 people, up 8.5 from the year-ago period, it said.
Coverage in urban areas reached 240 telephones per 1,000 people, it said but gave no comparative figure.
Mobile phone users increased by 2.9 million in the first six months to 9.7 million while pager users grew by 5.0 million to hit 30 million, it said.
